name: Terror Storm
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level death mage 9, shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

CAST

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level.

Effect 360-ft.-radius storm cloud
Duration concentration (maximum 10 rounds) (D)
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an evil-looking black storm cloud in the air. Each creature under the cloud must succeed on a Will save or be shaken for 1d4 x 10 minutes.

Each round you continue to concentrate, the spell generates additional effects as noted below.

Each effect occurs on your turn.

2nd Round: Negative energy floods the area, dealing 1d6 points of negative energy damage to living creatures (no save), undead are not healed by this negative energy.

3rd Round: You call six bolts of lightning down from the cloud. You decide where the bolts strike. No two bolts may be directed at the same target. Each bolt deals 10d6 points of electricity damage. A creature struck can attempt a Reflex save for half damage.

4th Round: Hailstones rain down in the area, dealing 5d6 points of bludgeoning damage (no save).

5th through 10th Rounds: All living creatures take 1d6 negative energy damage (no save) and must make a Will save or be panicked for 1 round.

Positive energy spells deal half the amount of damage or heal half the amount of wounds in the area.
